command -- python3 -c 'import jsonl_changed as m

# Basic parse, whitespace skip, CRLF, final line without newline
assert m.parse_jsonl('"'"'{"a": 1}\n\n  \n{"b": 2}'"'"') == [{"a": 1}, {"b": 2}]
assert m.parse_jsonl('"'"'{"a": 1}\r\n{"b": 2}'"'"') == [{"a": 1}, {"b": 2}]
assert m.parse_jsonl('"'"'{"a": 1}'"'"') == [{"a": 1}]

# Unicode
assert m.parse_jsonl('"'"'{"name": "café"}'"'"') == [{"name": "café"}]

# Malformed non-blank line raises ValueError
for bad in ['"'"'{bad}'"'"', '"'"'not json'"'"', '"'"'{"a": }'"'"']:
    try:
        m.parse_jsonl(bad)
        raise AssertionError('"'"'expected ValueError'"'"')
    except ValueError:
        pass

# Duplicate keys at top level
for dup in ['"'"'{"a": 1, "a": 2}'"'"', '"'"'{"a": 1, "b": {"c": 1, "c": 2}}'"'"', '"'"'[{"x": 1, "x": 2}]'"'"']:
    try:
        m.parse_jsonl(dup)
        raise AssertionError('"'"'expected ValueError for duplicate'"'"')
    except ValueError:
        pass

# Non-duplicate nested keys are fine
assert m.parse_jsonl('"'"'{"a": {"b": 1, "c": 2}}'"'"') == [{"a": {"b": 1, "c": 2}}]

print('"'"'all checks passed'"'"')
'
